name: Lone Rider Auxiliary Lights
description: Motorcycle Lights Set (2 Pods) + Bar Clamp Mount | No MotoCAN • High power output with an insane reach (1 lux at 700m / 2300 feet). • E-Approved ECE R10, R148, R149 road legal certification. • Speed Blending Technology™. • Amber / White DRL light ring – enhances safety and looks.
source_description_html:
Motorcycle Lights Set (2 Pods) + Bar Clamp Mount | No MotoCAN

We've entered the world of high-end motorcycle lighting. After years of dedicated research and development, we are thrilled to introduce what we confidently believe are the best motorcycle lights ever made – no compromises, no doubts.

Crafted with direct input from thousands of riders, these lights deliver the perfect beam pattern and light spectrum for the ultimate riding experience.

— 5 reasons to get the Motorcycle Lights

  • High power output with an insane reach (1 lux at 700m / 2300 feet)

  • E-Approved ECE R10, R148, R149 road legal certification

  • Speed Blending Technology™

  • Amber / White DRL light ring – enhances safety and looks

  • Greatly customizable through the included software

— Key Features

  1. DRL ring light
    The integrated light ring enhances your bike’s appearance while increasing visibility to other road users. It can be toggled between Amber and White, with 10 adjustable power levels, or turned off entirely for a more customized look and functionality.

  2. Wide beam
    The lower 4 LEDs provide a strong and wide beam to increase visibility closer to the bike.

  3. High beam
    The upper 4 LEDs provide a strong and long beam so you can see farther.

  4. Spot beam
    The center LED focuses the beam 2° for an exceptional reach (1 lux at 700m / 2300 feet).

  5. Temperature control
    The Motorcycle Lights are equipped with large, high-performing heat sinks to keep them cool during long usage.

  6. Strong mounting
    The Motorcycle Lights are equipped with a heavy duty mounting bracket, making them resistant to use in harsh environments.

  7. 100% dust- & waterproof
    The Motorcycle Lights have the classification IP68-69K which makes them highly resistant to fine dust and close-range high pressure, high temperature spray-downs.

  8. Fully customizable
    Thanks to the MotoCAN, you can access and customize the Motorcycle Lights according to your needs and preferences. Change the color of the DRL ring, change the power output for Day and Night modes, adjust the Speed Blending Technology, and much more.

— Dimensions & Weight (per pod)

  • Diameter: 4.4” / 114mm
  • Depth: 2.9” / 75mm
  • Height with bracket: 4.9” / 125mm
  • Weight: 840g / 29.63oz

— Materials used

  • Housing: Aluminum
  • Lens: Polycarbonate
  • Bracket: Stainless Steel
